app.title: Mosaicast
about.heading: About
about.whatBody: This site runs on Mosaicast, an open-source home for podcasts. It brings a show's feeds together, gives every episode its own page and grows with plugins.
about.pluginsBody: What this site runs, and who made it.
about.builtBody: Mosaicast is built on lots of other people's work.
about.buildHeading: Used to build and test it
tabs.label: Podcasts
filter.label: Filters
feed.emptyHint: Try a different season or tag, or clear the filters.
feed.loadMoreError: Couldn't load more episodes. Try again.
share.heading: Share
copy.manual: Your browser didn't allow copying. The text is selected, so press {{keys}} to copy it.
episode.noNotes: No show notes for this episode.
episode.quiet: Only podcasters and admins can see this planned episode. It goes public when someone announces it or the feed brings it.
episode.quietUntil: Only podcasters and admins can see this planned episode until {{date}}, or until the feed brings it.
episode.numbersHint: The numbers this site shows. Once you save them, feed updates won't change them.
account.title: Account
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.kind.name-reverted: An admin changed your display name back to “{{current}}”. It was “{{previous}}”.
notifications.kind.export-ready: Your data is ready to download from your account page.
account.playbackDevice: This applies to this browser only. Set it on each device you use.
account.tokensHelp: For scripts and other tools. Send it as a Bearer token.
account.tokenOnce: Copy your token now. You won't see it again:
account.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? Anything using it stops working right away.
account.lastIdentity: You can't remove your only login.
account.name.heading: Display name
account.name.label: Your name
account.name.help: Other people on this site see this name. It comes from the account you signed in with, and you can change it.
account.name.failed: Couldn't change your name. Try again.
account.name.display-name-refused: That name isn't available. Pick another one.
account.name.display-name-taken: Someone else already uses that name.
account.name.display-name-locked: You changed your name recently. Try again later.
account.avatar.heading: Picture
account.avatar.help: This site serves your picture itself, so nobody sees which account it came from.
loginError.account_conflict: That account is already linked to another user. Log in the usual way, then link it in your account.
loginError.link_required: An account with that email already exists. Log in the usual way, then link this one in your account.
loginError.signups_closed: You can't create an account yet. Sign-ups open with the site.
auth.signInRequired: Sign in to see this page
auth.signInRequiredBody: This page is for signed-in visitors. Log in at the top and you'll stay right here.
admin.forbiddenBody: You don't have access to this area.
admin.title: Admin
admin.languages.title: Languages
admin.languages.intro: Choose the languages for the interface and for content. To add a language, drop a catalog file into the languages folder.
admin.languages.dropInHint: Extra catalogs are read from {{dir}}. Name each file after its language code: nl.json.
admin.languages.noDropInDir: No languages folder is set. Set MOSAICAST_LOCALES_DIR to add languages without a rebuild.
admin.navigation.title: Navigation
admin.navigation.intro: Choose which plugin pages show up in the site menu, and in what order. Feeds show up on their own.
admin.navigation.empty: No plugin has a page, so the menu shows only feeds.
admin.navigation.reorderHint: Drag a row or use the arrows. The site menu uses this order.
admin.navigation.labelsNote: Entry names come from each plugin and aren't translated.
admin.plugins.title: Plugins
admin.plugins.rejectedWarning: {{count}} plugin(s) failed to load and are off. The reason is below.
admin.plugins.stopsAtRestart: Off. It no longer shows up, serves data or runs tasks. Its backend stops at the next restart.
admin.plugins.valueHidden: Hidden. Only admins can see and change this.
admin.plugins.storage.title: File storage
admin.plugins.storage.overridden: Set here. Clear it to use what the plugin asks for.
admin.plugins.storage.fromManifest: The plugin asks for {{quota}}. A value here overrides that.
admin.plugins.storage.fromDefault: Uses this site's default. A value here overrides it.
admin.plugins.storage.hardCap: This server allows at most {{max}} per plugin.
admin.plugins.storage.serverCap: This server takes uploads up to {{max}} per file, so that's the limit. To raise it, set MOSAICAST_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE.
admin.plugins.storage.belowUsage: That's less than what's already stored. Nothing gets deleted, but new uploads fail until files are removed.
admin.plugins.purgeConfirm: Delete all data stored by "{{name}}"? Its settings and on/off state stay. You can't undo this.
admin.plugins.readsAllUsers: Reads every user's data for this plugin at once, for leaderboards or totals.
admin.plugins.access.title: Who can reach its data
admin.plugins.external.title: External services
admin.plugins.external.uses: Uses: {{kinds}}. Calls go through this site's provider and account.
admin.plugins.external.usedBy: Its interface can trigger a call for {{role}} and above.
admin.plugins.external.usedByAnyone: Anyone can trigger a call from its interface, signed in or not. With a pay-per-call provider, anyone can run up your bill.
consent.title: Before you carry on
consent.intro: This site stores what it needs to work: your session, your language and this choice. Some content comes from other companies that store things on your device too. You decide about those.
consent.pendingAnnouncement: A privacy choice is waiting at the top of the page.
consent.reloadPending: Your choice takes full effect when the page reloads, once playback pauses.
consent.nothingOptional: Nothing on this site comes from other companies, so there's nothing to allow or refuse.
consent.gpc: Your browser asks sites not to share your data (Global Privacy Control), so nothing optional loads. You can still allow things here.
consent.categoryHint.necessary: Always loads, because the site can't work without it.
consent.categoryHint.functional: Content from other companies, such as players, maps or widgets.
consent.categoryHint.analytics: Counts visits so the people running this site see what gets read.
consent.categoryHint.other: Content from other companies, used by an add-on on this site. The services below say who and what.
consent.categoryHint.unreviewed: An add-on says the site needs this to work. The people running the site haven't confirmed that yet, so until they do, it's your choice.
consent.thirdCountry: Data may be transferred outside the EU/EEA
consent.storage.name: Name
consent.essential.title: Always active
consent.essential.intro: This is what the site itself stores on your device. The site needs it to work, and it's never used to profile you.
consent.essential.services: The site needs these services, so you can't switch them off. Here's what they store.
consent.account.intro: When you're signed in, this site also keeps the following in your account. It's used for nothing else, and deleting your account deletes it.
consent.account.emailPurpose: Comes from the service you sign in with. Used to recognise you and to link a second sign-in method to your account
consent.account.profilePurpose: Shown with your account, and next to anything you contribute
consent.account.progressPurpose: So an episode picks up where you left off on any device you sign in on, while remembering the position is on
consent.account.notificationsPurpose: Messages sent to you on this site
consent.account.tokensPurpose: Only if you create one, to use the site from another program
consent.retention.untilSwitchedOff: Until you switch remembering off, or delete your account
consent.retention.notifications: Read ones for a time this site sets (30 days by default). Unread ones until you read them or delete your account
consent.retention.untilRevoked: Until you revoke it, or delete your account
consent.purpose.csrf: Stops other sites from acting in your name
consent.purpose.site: Remembers the site's colours so the page doesn't flash white on load
consent.purpose.consent: Remembers the choice you make here
consent.purpose.consentCookie: Tells the server what you allowed, so it can block the rest
consent.purpose.progressPref: Remembers whether you want your position saved
consent.purpose.rate: Remembers the playback speed you set
consent.purpose.nowPlaying: Remembers which episode you were playing, so the player is still there after a reload
consent.duration.signedIn_one: Until you log out, or {{count}} day after your last visit
consent.duration.signedIn_other: Until you log out, or {{count}} days after your last visit
consent.progress.title: Remember where I stopped listening
consent.progress.hint: Saved once you press play. It stays on this device, and in your account when you're signed in, so it follows you. Switching it off deletes both.
consent.progress.gpc: Off because your browser asked sites not to track you. Switching it on here allows it for this site.
consent.receipt.title: Your choice
consent.receipt.decidedAt: You decided on {{date}}. We'll ask again after 12 months, or when the services on this site change.
consent.receipt.none: You haven't made a choice yet.
admin.external.title: External services
admin.external.intro: Third-party services this site can use. None is on by default, and a service nobody set up makes no calls.
Free, open-source machine translation. Run it yourself or use a hosted instance.
Where LibreTranslate runs: http://libretranslate:5000. Private addresses also need MOSAICAST_EXTERNAL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.
Only if your instance uses API keys. Safer than a stored key, because it never ends up in a database backup.
For when you can't restart the app to set the variable above. Stored in the database.
How often this site may call the service.
admin.external.noProviders: No provider is installed for this kind.
admin.external.noEncryptionKey: MOSAICAST_ENCRYPTION_KEY isn't set, so credentials entered here are stored as plain text and end up in database backups. Set them through the environment if you can.
admin.seo.title: SEO & crawlers
admin.seo.intro: Choose which search engines and AI crawlers may read your site. Mosaicast tells them through robots.txt.
admin.seo.policy.allow.hint: treat AI crawlers like any other crawler
admin.seo.policy.block.hint: ask every AI crawler Mosaicast knows to stay away
admin.seo.catalogNote: Newer crawlers join this list in later updates.
admin.seo.notEnforced: Crawlers can ignore robots.txt. Most well-known ones follow it.
admin.access.title: Site access
admin.access.intro: Choose whether visitors see the site, a countdown, a maintenance page or a closed page. Staff always see the real site. These pages come from mosaicast-edge, which runs in front of Mosaicast.
admin.access.now.open: Right now: the site is open to everyone.
admin.access.now.scheduled: Right now: visitors see a countdown. The site opens {{when}}.
admin.access.now.maintenance: Right now: visitors see the maintenance page.
admin.access.now.closed: Right now: the site is closed to visitors.
admin.access.edge.connected: The edge is enforcing these settings (last report {{when}}, build {{build}}).
admin.access.edge.stale: The edge hasn't reported in for over a minute. Until it does, visitors may see the site no matter what's set here. Sign-ups stay closed while the site isn't open.
admin.access.edge.unknown: No edge is connected (MOSAICAST_EDGE_TOKEN isn't set). These settings only reach visitors when mosaicast-edge runs in front of the site. Without it, Mosaicast only blocks new sign-ups while the site isn't open.
admin.access.state.scheduled.hint: a countdown, then the site opens on its own at the time you set
admin.access.state.maintenance.hint: a page saying you're working on the site
admin.access.state.closed.hint: a page saying the site is closed, with no date
admin.access.endsAt.hint: Visitors see this as an estimate. The site doesn't reopen on its own; you reopen it here.
admin.access.passFloor: Who sees the real site meanwhile
admin.access.while: While the site is not open
admin.access.staffLogin.hint: when off, staff sign in at /_a/login
admin.access.signups.hint: lets a new team member sign up before launch; turn it off again afterwards
admin.access.openNow.confirm: The site opens in about 12 seconds. Anyone on the countdown sees it run out, then the site.
admin.access.loadFailed: Couldn't load the site access settings.
admin.reach.title: Reach
admin.reach.intro: How often pages get viewed and episodes played in the web player. No cookies, nothing stored on visitors' devices, nothing kept about anyone.
admin.reach.counting.hint: page views and web player plays on this site. The edge has its own switch under Site access
admin.reach.off: Counting is off. Nothing new gets counted, and earlier counts stay.
admin.reach.chart: Page views, plays and edge page views over the selected range
admin.reach.none: Nothing counted in this range yet.
admin.reach.edge.title: Edge
admin.reach.edge.off: The edge isn't counting (it's off under Site access).
admin.reach.edge.noReport: The edge hasn't reported in the last two minutes.
admin.reach.edge.peaks: Peak today: {{today}} · peak for the current site setting: {{policy}}
admin.reach.notes: Only the web player counts. Plays in podcast apps go straight to your audio host and never show up here. Reloads count as views.
admin.access.edgeCounting: Count anonymously on the edge's pages
admin.access.edgeCounting.hint: views of the countdown and other edge pages, and how many are waiting. Switching it off deletes what the edge hasn't reported yet. The countdown's "waiting" display stays
error.code.siteAccess.opensAt.tooSoon: Opening has to be at least a minute away. To open right away, use Open now.
error.code.siteAccess.opensAt.missing: A countdown needs a time to open at.
error.code.siteAccess.endsAt.past: The expected end has to be in the future.
admin.logs.title: Logs & health
admin.logs.last24h: {{errors}} errors, {{warnings}} warnings in the last 24 h
admin.logs.last24hErrorsOnly: {{errors}} errors in the last 24 h. Warnings aren't recorded (capture level ERROR)
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.confirmAdmin: Make {{name}} an admin? Admins can manage everything, including other users.
admin.users.revertHelp: Puts back this user's previous name. You can't pick the name; it comes from their own history.
admin.users.confirmRevert: Revert {{name}} to their previous name? They won't be able to change it again for a while.
admin.users.warnHelp: Your words go straight to this user. The warning is recorded under your name.
admin.users.selfLocked: You can't change your own role.
admin.site.name: Site name
admin.site.accentInvalid: Enter a colour as six hex digits, like #C8553D.
admin.site.accentContrast: This colour is hard to read as text. Buttons keep it, while links, the active tab and focus rings use a darker or lighter shade.
admin.site.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or ICO, up to 2 MB. No SVG.
admin.feeds.deleteConfirm_one: Delete "{{title}}" with its one episode? Show notes, tags, listening progress and plugin data go with it. You can't undo this.
admin.feeds.deleteConfirm_other: Delete "{{title}}" with all {{count}} episodes? Show notes, tags, listening progress and plugin data go with it. You can't undo this.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Something broke on this page. Try again or go back to the home page.
error.code.feed.url.notHttp: The feed address has to start with http:// or https://.
error.code.feed.url.blocked: That feed address can't be used. It has to be publicly reachable over http(s).
error.code.external.url.blocked: That address can't be used. It has to be public, or allowed in MOSAICAST_EXTERNAL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.
admin.planned.title: Planned episodes
admin.planned.intro: Plan an episode before it's out, so plugins can get ready for it. When the feed item arrives with the same season and number, it takes over the plan. Otherwise, match it below.
admin.planned.visibility.quiet.hint: until you announce it or the feed brings it
admin.planned.visibility.now.hint: listed now, playable once the feed item arrives
admin.planned.visibility.at.hint: hidden until then, or until the feed item arrives
admin.planned.matchIntro: Pick the episode the feed brought in for this plan. The plan keeps its address and everything prepared on it, and takes the feed's title, audio and dates. The duplicate episode is removed.
admin.planned.noCandidates: This feed has no released episodes to match yet.
admin.planned.candidateHasData: has plugin data, can't be matched
admin.planned.cancelConfirm: Cancel "{{title}}"? The planned episode and everything plugins prepared for it are deleted. You can't undo this.
error.code.planned.notPlanned: This episode is out. Its details come from the feed and can't be edited here.
error.code.planned.title.required: A planned episode needs a title.
error.code.planned.title.tooLong: A title can have up to 200 characters.
error.code.planned.number.invalid: Season and episode must be whole numbers, 0 or more.
error.code.planned.announceAt.invalid: That isn't a valid date and time.
error.code.planned.match.notCandidate: You can only match a released episode imported from the same feed.
error.code.planned.match.targetHasPlugin: That episode already has its own plugin data, so merging would lose it. Remove the data first, or keep both episodes.
error.code.site.crawlers.tooMany: The block list takes up to 200 crawler names, each up to 100 characters.
error.code.site.name.tooLong: The site name can have up to 100 characters.
error.code.legal.slug.invalid: A page address can use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64 characters.
slot.error: This part of the page couldn't load.
admin.legal.title: Legal pages
admin.legal.newSlug: Address of the new page, like privacy
admin.legal.draftWarning: This is an unsaved machine translation. Read it before you save, because links and formatting often come back broken.
admin.legal.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{slug}}" and all its translations? You can't undo this.
notFound.title: Not found
admin.consent.title: Declared services
admin.consent.intro: Every third-party service your active plugins declare, and which plugin declares it. Visitors see services and companies, never plugin names. Switching a plugin off removes its services.
admin.consent.none: No active plugin declares a third-party service, so visitors aren't asked anything.
admin.consent.cspIntro: The Content-Security-Policy allows these origins and no others, even after a visitor agrees.
admin.consent.necessaryPending: This plugin says visitors don't need to be asked about this service. You haven't confirmed that yet, so they're still asked.
admin.consent.necessaryApproved: You confirmed that visitors don't need to be asked about this service, so it loads for everyone.
admin.consent.approveNecessary: Confirm as needed to run the site
search.title: Search
search.label: Search this site
search.hint: Type something to search episodes and everything else on this site.
search.failed: The search didn't work. Try again.
search.timedOut: This section took too long to answer.
account.exportBody: Get everything this site knows about you in one ZIP file. You'll get a notification when it's ready.
account.exportFailed: Preparing your data didn't work. Try again.
account.exportExpired: Your last download expired and was deleted.
account.exportNext: You can prepare a new one from {{date}}.
account.exportTooSoon: You've already prepared your data recently. Try again later.
account.deleteBody: This removes your login, access tokens and listening progress, and erases or anonymises everything else this site holds about you. You can't undo this.
account.deleteDone: Your account and all its data are deleted.
account.deletePartial: Your account is deleted. Some parts of the site are still erasing your data and will finish later: {{plugins}}.
account.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the account. Try again.
admin.erasures.title: Unfinished account erasures
admin.erasures.help: These plugins haven't erased a deleted account's data yet. They're retried every hour, and a switched-off plugin catches up when you turn it back on.
admin.exports.title: Data exports
admin.exports.help: Recent requests for personal data, and what each plugin did. Only the person who asked can download the archive.
